name: Ashikoki Wakaoku-sama Shiboridashi Doumei
original_name: 足コキ若奥さま 搾り出し同盟
source:
Kotaro has been spotted masturbating by his young wife Misa. There is only surprise in her eyes, but no condemnation. Since then it has become a daily routine to observe each other's play. One day a photo arrives with Kotaro masturbating. There is a threatening line on it demanding to follow Misa lead. Protagonist has to abide and follow her instructions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
